name: com.coffeebean.asset
description: Asset management module for the CoffeeBean framework: unified loading facade over Unity Addressables (sync/async/instantiate/preload/label/ref-counted release/stats) + UI component binding extensions (Image/TMP_Text/Text/SpriteRenderer/AudioClip) + catalog update service. Declares com.unity.addressables as dependency (source provided by consumer). Depends on com.coffeebean.tools.
